title: I Sent 64,998 Letters to London Property Owners

cards.text: ~In this video~ / 65,000 letters, 11 sales / Why the worst reply rate sold the most / What happened to the pub / What off-market means / *Four things to have ready*
~January 2023 to October 2026~ / Letters sent: 64,998 / Replies: 329 / Valuations: 65 / Instructions to sell: 17 / *Sold: 11*
~Reply rate vs sales~ / East London: 0.3% replied · *9 sold* / North London: 1.4% replied · *1 sold*
~The Deanswift · Shadwell~ / Sold vacant · *£1,250,000* / Now open and trading / Hotel use applied for upstairs
~Off-market~ / Not cheap / Not a secret club / *First look, before the public launch*

captions: Since January 2023, | we've sent | [64,998 LETTERS] | to London | property owners. [329] of them | wrote back, | and [11] of those buildings | have now sold | for nearly | [£14 MILLION] | between them. The list that sold | the *most buildings* | had the [LOWEST] | reply rate | of any that we've sent. And the first deal | came from | a *single letter* | to a [DERELICT PUB] | in Shadwell. In this video, | I'll show you | how 65,000 letters | turned into | [11 SALES,] | why the *worst reply rate* | sold the most buildings, | what happened | to that pub, | what *off-market* | actually means | and what it doesn't, | and the [FOUR THINGS] | that you need ready | so you're the buyer | who gets the [CALL.] If you own property | that isn't | pulling its weight, | and you've spent months | on the portals | and everything decent | is either *gone* | or *overpriced,* | part of the reason | is that some of | the best buildings | are agreed | [BEFORE] | they're ever advertised. This video | shows you | how that happens. I'm Jake, | the founder of | Calibre Acquire, | based in London. | I've been in property | for [14 YEARS,] | and last year | we transacted on | over [£30 MILLION.] I help investors | get out of | *underperforming* | property assets | and into ones | that work [HARDER] | for them. Start with | the [SCALE.] [64,998] letters | went out | between January 2023 | and October this year. [329] owners replied. | That's about | [ONE IN EVERY 200.] Of those 329, | [65] asked us | to value | their building. [17] went on | to instruct us | to sell, | and [11] | have now *sold.* It works out at | roughly | [ONE SALE] | for every | [5,900 LETTERS.] Think of it like | knocking on | [200 DOORS] | to get one | to open. Most owners | aren't thinking | about selling | when the letter lands. Some keep it | in a drawer | for a *year,* | then something changes. | A tenant *leaves,* | a loan comes up | for *renewal,* | a partner | wants *out.* And that's when | they [CALL.] That's why | we write to | the same owner | every [THREE MONTHS.] The letter | isn't meant | to persuade anyone. It just needs | to be *there* | when the | timing changes. If you're thinking | about buying | or selling | a property, | we've built | a [VALUATION REPORT] | that does the work | for you. Put the details in | and you'll have | a full report | in a few minutes. It took us | hours to build, | and we normally | charge [£190] for it. Use the code | [SOCIALS] | and it's [FREE.] It's at | calibreacquire.co.uk/valuation-promotion. Now | the part that | [SURPRISED ME.] Our East London list | had a reply rate | of [0.3%.] North London | replied at [1.4%,] | nearly | *five times* higher. You'd expect | North | to sell more. | It [DIDN'T.] East London | sold [NINE] buildings. | North London | sold [ONE.] My best explanation | is the [FOLLOW-UPS.] We'd sent | the East London owners | more follow-up letters, | so when | their plans changed, | they *already had* | our name. The lesson | for anyone buying | is that | more enquiries | doesn't mean | [MORE DEALS.] What matters | is how many owners | actually | go through | with a [SALE.] The first deal | didn't come | from a campaign | at all. | It came from | [ONE LETTER.] Three years ago, | there was a | *derelict pub* | on Deancross Street | in Shadwell. I found the owner | through | Companies House | and wrote to them. They'd just had | a planning application | [REFUSED,] | and that's why | they were open | to a conversation. It sold vacant | for [£1.25 MILLION.] The buyer, | Emran, | matched the price | with [NO MORTGAGE.] Since then, | he's got planning | to change the use | of the ground floor, | and it's now | *open and trading.* He's applied | for upper floors | to become a [HOTEL,] | and once that's approved, | he's looking at | a yield | well over [10%.] So one letter | led to a *sale,* | a building | that's earning again, | and the company | I run [TODAY.] Off-market | gets *misunderstood,* | so it's worth | being clear about it. It doesn't mean | [CHEAP.] We don't sell | below market value | properties. Every building | we sell | is valued | on its *income,* | its *condition* | and its *location,* | the same as | it would be | on a portal. It isn't | a [SECRET CLUB] | either, | it's knocking | on the door | before the | for sale sign | goes up. What it gives | a buyer | is [TIME.] The investors | on our list | see a building | before it's advertised | anywhere public. If it isn't | under offer | by then, | it goes to a | full public launch, | and everyone else | sees it | after they've had | [FIRST LOOK.] The buyers | who get these buildings | are rarely the ones | with the *most money.* They're the ones | who are [READY.] There are | [FOUR THINGS] | to have in place. First, | your [CRITERIA.] Write down | the areas | and the type of building, | your price range | and the minimum yield | you'd expect. If you can't say it | in [ONE SENTENCE,] | an agent | can't match you | to anything. Then there's | [FINANCE.] Have an agreement | in principle | or proof of funds | *before* you view, | not after | you offer. There's also | your [SOLICITOR.] Line up one | who does | commercial and | mixed-use work | before you find | the building. A *residential* | conveyancer | can slow | a commercial deal | down by [WEEKS.] And then there's | [SPEED.] When the right building | comes up, | view it | within a few days | and decide | within a [WEEK.] Good buildings | don't wait | for *second viewings.* If you found this useful, | send it to someone | who's looking for | their next building. It could save them | a *significant amount* | on their next deal. If you want | to be kept up to date | with new | property strategies, | then [SUBSCRIBE.] If you want | to be notified | when properties | like this | become available, | you can register | at calibreacquire.co.uk/register. I look at | every registration | [PERSONALLY,] | and I'll reach out | if it's a good fit.
